summary.text: Brad Bekkedahl is a Republican state senator from District 1 in Williston who took office in December 2014 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A dentist and retired National Guard colonel, he chairs the Senate Appropriations Committee.

paragraphs.text: Brad Bekkedahl is a dentist who holds a B.A. from the University of Jamestown and a B.S. and a D.D.S. from the University of Minnesota.
He served in the U.S. Army Reserves from 1996 to 2002 and the North Dakota National Guard from 2002 to 2022, retiring with the rank of colonel.
Bekkedahl served on the Williston Park Board from 1988 to 1996 and has been Williston city finance commissioner since 1996, according to his legislative biography.
Ballotpedia lists him as succeeding Stanley W. Lyson in the Senate and as winning District 1 elections in 2014, 2018 and 2022.
In the 2025 regular session he chaired the Appropriations Committee, and during the 2026 special sessions he chaired the Joint Appropriations committee.
He also chairs the interim Tax Reform and Relief Advisory Committee and the interim Rural Health Transformation Committee.
